title: The last day of the range is left out
description: end is midnight at the start of the last day and the filter is < end, so that day's sales are missing although the summary says both days are included.

title: One database query per customer (N+1)
description: The loop queries Customers once per group after loading every order into memory; grouping in the database query does it in one round trip.

title: Average fails for a customer with no orders
description: Enumerable.Average throws InvalidOperationException on an empty sequence.
